identityFirewall.rule: HeroCel may change only how Sarah-as-Sarallel is rendered. It may not change whose facial geometry, hair geometry, body identity, costume geometry, or expression geometry is present.

frozenLikenessGeometry: broader shorter face through cheek region
natural adult eye size, shape, and spacing
broader softer nose width, base, and tip
warm broad smile with strong cheek lift
hair-down face framing and part geometry
frozenCharacterDesign: royal blue black and gold palette family
armor and crystal placement from Sarallel Design Master A

renderingOnlyTargets.facialValueGrouping: broad clean HeroCel planes while preserving all Sarah geometry
renderingOnlyTargets.skinRendering: 2-to-4 major value groups with restrained transitions; no photoreal continuous gradients
renderingOnlyTargets.eyeTreatment: contrast, catchlight, iris and lid readability only; never alter Sarah eye size, shape, spacing, tilt, or lid geometry
renderingOnlyTargets.noseTreatment: simplify light and shadow planes only; never narrow or sharpen nose geometry
renderingOnlyTargets.mouthTreatment: simplify contour and shadow treatment only; preserve mouth width and Sarah smile construction
renderingOnlyTargets.cheekJawTreatment: reduce shading noise only; preserve cheek fullness, jaw width, and rounded chin
renderingOnlyTargets.hairTreatment: group strands into animation-readable masses while preserving hairline, part, length family, and face framing
renderingOnlyTargets.armorTreatment: graphic material separation, broad value blocks, selective highlights, no geometry redesign
renderingOnlyTargets.crystalTreatment: high-contrast focal material with clean internal facets; preserve crystal geometry and placement
renderingOnlyTargets.detailHierarchy: face first, primary chest/waist crystals second, silhouette third, secondary armor detail last

hardReject: beauty normalization that weakens Sarah likeness
Kineza or other HeroCel calibration-character geometry transfer

generationContract.presentation: single neutral full-body Sarallel character master only; no sheet, no comparison layout, no alternate views, no text
visualReferenceStack: Sarallel Likeness Master A for Sarah likeness and hair-down appearance
Sarallel Design Master A for costume, body silhouette, crystals, cape, and magic
generationContract.artistInstruction: Draw Sarah as Sarallel using Prismatic HeroCel rendering grammar. Sarah supplies all facial and hair geometry. Sarallel Design Master A supplies costume, silhouette, crystals, cape, and magic. HeroCel supplies rendering treatment only. Do not normalize Sarah toward a generic animated heroine.
generationContract.geometryInstruction: No facial, hair, body-identity, costume, crystal, or cape geometry may be redesigned for style consistency.
generationContract.styleInstruction: Move the existing Sarallel Design Master A into HeroCel through value grouping, edge discipline, material abstraction, and detail hierarchy only.

passTarget.comparisonMethod: After likeness/design retention passes, compare untouched Sarallel HeroCel Master B beside untouched Prismel HeroCel Master B and untouched Kineza master. Never regenerate the characters together for the same-artist test.
